collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A heartbroken villager wants to sing a sad song about their breakup at the gathering: sing it, or sing something else.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s sweetheart left (subject.him/her) last month, and (subject) has written a long, very sad song about it. (subject.He/she) wants to sing it at the gathering. (friend), (subject.his/her) friend, points out that the former sweetheart will be there, and that the song mentions (other.his/her) cooking very unkindly. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) sings it, cooking verse and all. The former sweetheart walks out halfway. Everyone else is very uncomfortable. Afterwards, (subject) feels better and worse at the same time. The next day (subject.he/she) takes the cooking verse out.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) sings an old sad song instead, one everyone knows. Half the gathering sings with (subject.him/her), because everyone has had their heart broken at some point. (subject) cries through the last verse. Several people hug (subject.him/her) afterwards.
